LanguageData.LP_AetherArtificerArmor.label: artificer power armor
LanguageData.LP_AetherArtificerArmor.description: Power armor with a bronze shell and an aether core set in the chest. Mithril servos make it more agile than vanilla power armor, and the tool rig on the back and aether assist make the wearer work faster.\n\nSlightly stronger than marine armor, and only slightly slower.
LanguageData.LP_AetherAcolyteHelm.label: artificer rebreather helm
LanguageData.LP_AetherAcolyteHelm.description: A fully enclosed helmet matching the artificer power armor; amber visors with built-in targeting assist shorten aiming time.
LanguageData.LP_AetherBastionArmor.label: oathbound bastion armor
LanguageData.LP_AetherBastionArmor.description: Steel-grey adamantine plate with gilded trim and rows of aether lattice on the chest and shoulders. Heavier than any vanilla armor; the wearer barely feels pain but walks very slowly.\n\nThe grey plating can be dyed.
LanguageData.LP_AetherBastionHelm.label: bastion great helm
LanguageData.LP_AetherBastionHelm.description: A gilded great helm matching the oathbound bastion armor, with a glowing vision slit behind the visor. Heavy but does not block sight, and keeps the wearer clear-headed under impact.\n\nThe grey parts can be dyed.
